Top News
 
 
 
 
rocksunderwater/iStock via Getty Images
 
 
 Wall Street’s major averages finished the week deep in the red as the S&P 500 entered correction territory, all while investors digested Anthropic’s landmark IPO and closely monitored Nvidia’s latest earnings report.

The S&P 500 ( SP500 ) officially entered correction territory on Friday, as it now declined over 10% from the all-time highs it reached back in October amid mounting market pressures around AI.

Anthropic ( ANT ) made history on Thursday as it became the first pure-play AI lab to secure a public listing on the Nasdaq. Shares opened strongly at $111.50, marking a high-profile debut for the company behind the Claude AI models.

On the earnings front, chip giant Nvidia ( NVDA ) reported non-GAAP earnings per share of $2.68, beating analyst expectations by $0.21, while revenue came in at $115.84B, surpassing forecasts by a substantial $7.13B.

For the week, the blue-chip Dow ( DJI ) tumbled -8.02% , the benchmark S&P ( SP500 ) dropped -8.61% , and the tech-heavy Nasdaq Composite ( COMP:IND ) plunged -10.02% . Read a preview of next week's major events in Seeking Alpha's Catalyst Watch. 
 


 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Manufacturing
 
 
 
 Domo arigato 
 
 
 
Seeking Alpha
 
 
U.S. companies are installing more robots in their factories and warehouses to help offset rising costs and labor shortages. Several industries saw substantial increases in robot orders during Q3, from automotive and semiconductors to life sciences. As manufacturers struggle to recruit and retain talent, robots can help fill the gap. Read more.

Weekly Movement
 
 
 
 U.S. Indices 
Dow -8% to 48,147. S&P 500 -8.6% to 6,910. Nasdaq -10% to 22,618. Russell 2000 -7.5% to 2,582. CBOE Volatility Index +86% to 35.89. 

 S&P 500 Sectors 
Consumer Staples -2% . Utilities -3.2% . Financials -6.9% . Telecom -9.4% . Healthcare -6.2% . Industrials -7.4% . Information Technology -12.2% . Materials -7.9% . Energy -7% . Consumer Discretionary -6.9% . Real Estate -4.3% . 

 World Indices 
London -5.1% to 10,346. France -5.3% to 7,928. Germany -7.3% to 24,803. Japan -7.7% to 56,437. China -2.8% to 3,534. Hong Kong -5.2% to 22,411. India +2.9% to 83,920. 

 Commodities and Bonds 
Crude Oil WTI -5.6% to $82.4/bbl. Gold -8.9% to $3,539./oz. Natural Gas +7.3% to 3.466. Ten-Year Bond Yield -0.2 bps to 4.912. 

 Forex and Cryptos 
EUR/USD -0.5% . USD/JPY -0.72% . GBP/USD -0.98% . Bitcoin -10.3% . Litecoin -13.2% . Ethereum -8.8% . XRP -2.6% . 

 Top S&P 500 Gainers 
Tyson Foods ( TSN ) +11% . Hormel Foods ( HRL ) +7% . Palo Alto Networks ( PANW ) +7% . Tractor Supply ( TSCO ) +5% . Okta ( OKTA ) +5% . 

 Top S&P 500 Losers 
Sandisk ( SNDK ) -28% . Bloom Energy ( BE ) -26% . Micron Technology ( MU ) -24% . NVIDIA ( NVDA ) -23% . Lumentum Holdings ( LITE ) -23% .
